import bpy,json
from mathutils import Vector
c=bpy.data.collections['Shipyard_COMBINED_Craft']
rs=[]
for o in c.objects:
 if any(k in o.get('source_component','').lower() for k in ['rescue','mallet','sledge']) or o.name.endswith('open air workbench top'):
  pts=[o.matrix_world@Vector(p) for p in o.bound_box]
  rs.append({'name':o.name,'source':o.get('source_component',''),'bounds':[[min(p[i] for p in pts) for i in range(3)],[max(p[i] for p in pts) for i in range(3)]],'mat':[m.name for m in o.data.materials],'local': [list(v.co) for v in o.data.vertices[:8]] if o.type=='MESH' else []})
print(json.dumps(rs))
print('FORGED USERS',[(o.name,[m.name for m in o.data.materials]) for o in c.objects if any(m and m.name=='HarborCraft_CraneForgedIron' for m in o.data.materials)][:45])
